prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Reception now clusters at matching marks: Sensor.Community at 7 min ago [F3] and DanubeHIS also at 7 min ago [F35], while Parking Servis at 12 min ago [F4] lines up with RHMZ automatic stations also at 12 min ago [F27] - a cadence coincidence worth checking rather than a shared cause. Skeptic is right that Parking Servis carries no measurement time, so the Masarikova shift from 3 to 255 [F5] is a span between receptions, not a flow with a clock; it says nothing about when spaces actually filled or emptied. The Tanjug headline on water in Grocka [F6] and the five other fresh headlines [F7, F8, F9, F10] carry no confirmed location or time, so none of them can yet be tied to Sensor.Community's 7764 values [F3] or any instrument.
